[31m+   return new Promise((resolve) => {[39m
[31m+     const t = window.setTimeout(() => resolve(fallback), ms);[39m
[31m+     void promise.then([39m
[31m+       (v) => {[39m
[31m+         window.clearTimeout(t);[39m
[31m+         resolve(v);[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       () => {[39m
[31m+         window.clearTimeout(t);[39m
[31m+         resolve(fallback);[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   mode: "incremental" | "full";[39m
[31m+   entityWrites: number;[39m
[31m+   bytesWritten: number;[39m

[31m+ function diffById<T extends { id: string }>(prev: T[], next: T[]): { upserts: T[]; removedIds: string[] } {[39m
[31m+   const prevMap = new Map(prev.map((x) => [x.id, x]));[39m
[31m+   const nextMap = new Map(next.map((x) => [x.id, x]));[39m
[31m+   const upserts: T[] = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const row of next) {[39m
[31m+     const old = prevMap.get(row.id);[39m
[31m+     if (old !== row) upserts.push(row);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const removedIds: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const id of prevMap.keys()) {[39m
[31m+     if (!nextMap.has(id)) removedIds.push(id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return { upserts, removedIds };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ async function persistArrayDelta<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   bucket: EntityBucket,[39m
[31m+   prev: T[],[39m
[31m+   next: T[],[39m
[31m+   sortKey: (row: T) => string,[39m
[31m+   stats: { entityWrites: number; bytesWritten: number },[39m
[31m+   opts?: { removeIds?: "all" | ReadonlySet<string> },[39m
[31m+ ): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+   const { upserts, removedIds } = diffById(prev, next);[39m
[31m+   if (upserts.length === 0 && removedIds.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+   if (upserts.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     await putEntitiesBatch([39m
[31m+       bucket,[39m
[31m+       upserts.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, data: row, sortKey: sortKey(row) })),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     stats.entityWrites += upserts.length;[39m
[31m+     stats.bytesWritten += upserts.reduce((n, row) => n + JSON.stringify(row).length, 0);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const allow = opts?.removeIds ?? "all";[39m
[31m+   for (const id of removedIds) {[39m
[31m+     if (allow !== "all" && !allow.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     await deleteEntityRecord(bucket, id);[39m
[31m+     stats.entityWrites += 1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * RAM sales are a complete authoritative dataset only after staged hydration[39m
[31m+  * has finished. Critical/interactive/background windows, and an in-flight[39m
[31m+  * salesHistoryHydration, are partial — missing IDs are not deletes.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ export function isSalesPersistAuthoritative(state: {[39m
[31m+   salesHistoryHydration?: { active: boolean } | null;[39m
[31m+   hydrationStage?: PosState["hydrationStage"];[39m
[31m+ }): boolean {[39m
[31m+   if (state.salesHistoryHydration?.active === true) return false;[39m
[31m+   const stage = state.hydrationStage;[39m
[31m+   if (stage === "critical" || stage === "interactive" || stage === "background") return false;[39m
[31m+   return true;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ /** Sale rows that left RAM because they were archived or void-tombstoned. */[39m
[31m+ export function explainedSaleEntityRemovals([39m
[31m+   next: Pick<PosState, "archivedSales" | "voidRecords" | "archivedVoidRecords">,[39m
[31m+   manifest: { voidedSaleIds?: Record<string, string> },[39m
[31m+ ): Set<string> {[39m
[31m+   const ids = new Set<string>();[39m
[31m+   for (const s of next.archivedSales) ids.add(s.id);[39m
[31m+   for (const id of Object.keys(manifest.voidedSaleIds ?? {})) ids.add(id);[39m
[31m+   for (const v of next.voidRecords) ids.add(v.saleId);[39m
[31m+   for (const v of next.archivedVoidRecords) ids.add(v.saleId);[39m
[31m+   return ids;[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function salesOrderFromArray(sales: Sale[]): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return sales.map((s) => s.id);[39m

[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * SYNC-01 / R2 — a non-authoritative sales persist must not shrink the[39m
[31m+  * manifest. RAM order is newest-first; IDs still on disk (including ones that[39m
[31m+  * merely left this persist's previous RAM) are appended in existing order.[39m
[31m+  * Voided / archived IDs are allowed to leave salesOrder. Authoritative[39m
[31m+  * persists normalize to RAM.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ export function resolveSalesOrderForIncrementalPersist(input: {[39m
[31m+   existingSalesOrder: string[];[39m
[31m+   prevSales: Sale[];[39m
[31m+   nextSales: Sale[];[39m
[31m+   nextArchivedSales: Sale[];[39m
[31m+   voidedSaleIds?: Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+   /** True when RAM is a partial/hydration dataset, not a complete authority. */[39m
[31m+   salesHistoryHydrationActive: boolean;[39m
[31m+ }): string[] {[39m
[31m+   const ramOrder = salesOrderFromArray(input.nextSales);[39m
[31m+   if (!input.salesHistoryHydrationActive) {[39m
[31m+     return ramOrder;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const seen = new Set(ramOrder);[39m
[31m+   const archived = new Set(input.nextArchivedSales.map((s) => s.id));[39m
[31m+   const voided = input.voidedSaleIds ?? {};[39m
[31m+   const preserved: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const id of input.existingSalesOrder) {[39m
[31m+     if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     if (voided[id]) continue;[39m
[31m+     if (archived.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     preserved.push(id);[39m
[31m+     seen.add(id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return [...ramOrder, ...preserved];[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ [39m
[31m+ function diffById<T extends { id: string }>(prev: T[], next: T[]): { upserts: T[]; removedIds: string[] } {[39m
[31m+   const prevMap = new Map(prev.map((x) => [x.id, x]));[39m
[31m+   const nextMap = new Map(next.map((x) => [x.id, x]));[39m
[31m+   const upserts: T[] = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const row of next) {[39m
[31m+     const old = prevMap.get(row.id);[39m
[31m+     if (old !== row) upserts.push(row);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const removedIds: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const id of prevMap.keys()) {[39m
[31m+     if (!nextMap.has(id)) removedIds.push(id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return { upserts, removedIds };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ async function persistArrayDelta<T extends { id: string }>([39m
[31m+   bucket: EntityBucket,[39m
[31m+   prev: T[],[39m
[31m+   next: T[],[39m
[31m+   sortKey: (row: T) => string,[39m
[31m+   stats: { entityWrites: number; bytesWritten: number },[39m
[31m+   opts?: { removeIds?: "all" | ReadonlySet<string> },[39m
[31m+ ): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+   const { upserts, removedIds } = diffById(prev, next);[39m
[31m+   if (upserts.length === 0 && removedIds.length === 0) return;[39m
[31m+   if (upserts.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     await putEntitiesBatch([39m
[31m+       bucket,[39m
[31m+       upserts.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, data: row, sortKey: sortKey(row) })),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     stats.entityWrites += upserts.length;[39m
[31m+     stats.bytesWritten += upserts.reduce((n, row) => n + JSON.stringify(row).length, 0);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const allow = opts?.removeIds ?? "all";[39m
[31m+   for (const id of removedIds) {[39m
[31m+     if (allow !== "all" && !allow.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     await deleteEntityRecord(bucket, id);[39m
[31m+     stats.entityWrites += 1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * RAM sales are a complete authoritative dataset only after staged hydration[39m
[31m+  * has finished. Critical/interactive/background windows, and an in-flight[39m
[31m+  * salesHistoryHydration, are partial — missing IDs are not deletes.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ export function isSalesPersistAuthoritative(state: {[39m
[31m+   salesHistoryHydration?: { active: boolean } | null;[39m
[31m+   hydrationStage?: PosState["hydrationStage"];[39m
[31m+ }): boolean {[39m
[31m+   if (state.salesHistoryHydration?.active === true) return false;[39m
[31m+   const stage = state.hydrationStage;[39m
[31m+   if (stage === "critical" || stage === "interactive" || stage === "background") return false;[39m
[31m+   return true;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ /** Sale rows that left RAM because they were archived or void-tombstoned. */[39m
[31m+ export function explainedSaleEntityRemovals([39m
[31m+   next: Pick<PosState, "archivedSales" | "voidRecords" | "archivedVoidRecords">,[39m
[31m+   manifest: { voidedSaleIds?: Record<string, string> },[39m
[31m+ ): Set<string> {[39m
[31m+   const ids = new Set<string>();[39m
[31m+   for (const s of next.archivedSales) ids.add(s.id);[39m
[31m+   for (const id of Object.keys(manifest.voidedSaleIds ?? {})) ids.add(id);[39m
[31m+   for (const v of next.voidRecords) ids.add(v.saleId);[39m
[31m+   for (const v of next.archivedVoidRecords) ids.add(v.saleId);[39m
[31m+   return ids;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ function salesOrderFromArray(sales: Sale[]): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return sales.map((s) => s.id);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ /**[39m
[31m+  * SYNC-01 / R2 — a non-authoritative sales persist must not shrink the[39m
[31m+  * manifest. RAM order is newest-first; IDs still on disk (including ones that[39m
[31m+  * merely left this persist's previous RAM) are appended in existing order.[39m
[31m+  * Voided / archived IDs are allowed to leave salesOrder. Authoritative[39m
[31m+  * persists normalize to RAM.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ export function resolveSalesOrderForIncrementalPersist(input: {[39m
[31m+   existingSalesOrder: string[];[39m
[31m+   prevSales: Sale[];[39m
[31m+   nextSales: Sale[];[39m
[31m+   nextArchivedSales: Sale[];[39m
[31m+   voidedSaleIds?: Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+   /** True when RAM is a partial/hydration dataset, not a complete authority. */[39m
[31m+   salesHistoryHydrationActive: boolean;[39m
[31m+ }): string[] {[39m
[31m+   const ramOrder = salesOrderFromArray(input.nextSales);[39m
[31m+   if (!input.salesHistoryHydrationActive) {[39m
[31m+     return ramOrder;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const seen = new Set(ramOrder);[39m
[31m+   const archived = new Set(input.nextArchivedSales.map((s) => s.id));[39m
[31m+   const voided = input.voidedSaleIds ?? {};[39m
[31m+   const preserved: string[] = [];[39m
[31m+   for (const id of input.existingSalesOrder) {[39m
[31m+     if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     if (voided[id]) continue;[39m
[31m+     if (archived.has(id)) continue;[39m
[31m+     preserved.push(id);[39m
[31m+     seen.add(id);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   return [...ramOrder, ...preserved];[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ /** Incremental entity writes — normal POS operations. */[39m
[31m+ export async function flushIncrementalPersist(prev: PosState, next: PosState): Promise<IncrementalPersistResult> {[39m
[31m+   const started = performance.now();[39m
[31m+   const stats = { entityWrites: 0, bytesWritten: 0 };[39m
[31m+   const manifest = await ensureEntityManifest(next.preferences);[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   if (prev.preferences !== next.preferences) {[39m
[31m+     manifest.preferences = next.preferences;[39m
[31m+     stats.bytesWritten += JSON.stringify(next.preferences).length;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("product", prev.products, next.products, (p) => p.updatedAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("customer", prev.customers, next.customers, (c) => c.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("sale", prev.sales, next.sales, (s) => s.createdAt, stats, {[39m
[31m+     // Partial RAM (hydration / staged bootstrap) may only delete explained ids.[39m
[31m+     removeIds: isSalesPersistAuthoritative(next) ? "all" : explainedSaleEntityRemovals(next, manifest),[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("archivedSale", prev.archivedSales, next.archivedSales, (s) => s.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("debtPayment", prev.debtPayments, next.debtPayments, (d) => d.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("dayClose", prev.dayCloses, next.dayCloses, (d) => d.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("auditLog", prev.auditLogs, next.auditLogs, (a) => a.at, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("supplier", prev.suppliers, next.suppliers, (s) => s.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("purchase", prev.purchases, next.purchases, (p) => p.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("supplierPayment", prev.supplierPayments, next.supplierPayments, (p) => p.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("stockMovement", prev.stockMovements, next.stockMovements, (m) => m.at, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "archivedStockMovement",[39m
[31m+     prev.archivedStockMovements ?? [],[39m
[31m+     next.archivedStockMovements ?? [],[39m
[31m+     (m) => m.at,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("voidRecord", prev.voidRecords, next.voidRecords, (v) => v.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("returnRecord", prev.returnRecords, next.returnRecords, (r) => r.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta("cashExpense", prev.cashExpenses, next.cashExpenses, (e) => e.createdAt, stats);[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "cashDrawerAdjustment",[39m
[31m+     prev.cashDrawerAdjustments,[39m
[31m+     next.cashDrawerAdjustments,[39m
[31m+     (a) => a.occurredAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "dayDrawerOpen",[39m
[31m+     prev.dayDrawerOpens,[39m
[31m+     next.dayDrawerOpens,[39m
[31m+     (d) => d.countedAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "inventoryCountSession",[39m
[31m+     prev.inventoryCountSessions,[39m
[31m+     next.inventoryCountSessions,[39m
[31m+     (s) => s.updatedAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "archivedAuditLog",[39m
[31m+     prev.archivedAuditLogs,[39m
[31m+     next.archivedAuditLogs,[39m
[31m+     (a) => a.at,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "archivedDayClose",[39m
[31m+     prev.archivedDayCloses,[39m
[31m+     next.archivedDayCloses,[39m
[31m+     (d) => d.createdAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "archivedVoidRecord",[39m
[31m+     prev.archivedVoidRecords,[39m
[31m+     next.archivedVoidRecords,[39m
[31m+     (v) => v.createdAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "archivedReturnRecord",[39m
[31m+     prev.archivedReturnRecords,[39m
[31m+     next.archivedReturnRecords,[39m
[31m+     (r) => r.createdAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "pharmacyPrescription",[39m
[31m+     prev.pharmacyPrescriptions ?? [],[39m
[31m+     next.pharmacyPrescriptions ?? [],[39m
[31m+     (r) => r.updatedAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "pharmacyDoctor",[39m
[31m+     prev.pharmacyDoctors ?? [],[39m
[31m+     next.pharmacyDoctors ?? [],[39m
[31m+     (d) => d.updatedAt,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   await persistArrayDelta([39m
[31m+     "pharmacyControlledRegister",[39m
[31m+     prev.pharmacyControlledRegister ?? [],[39m
[31m+     next.pharmacyControlledRegister ?? [],[39m
[31m+     (e) => e.at,[39m
[31m+     stats,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   if (prev.sales !== next.sales) {[39m
[31m+     manifest.salesOrder = resolveSalesOrderForIncrementalPersist({[39m
[31m+       existingSalesOrder: manifest.salesOrder,[39m
[31m+       prevSales: prev.sales,[39m
[31m+       nextSales: next.sales,[39m
[31m+       nextArchivedSales: next.archivedSales,[39m
[31m+       voidedSaleIds: manifest.voidedSaleIds,[39m
[31m+       salesHistoryHydrationActive: !isSalesPersistAuthoritative(next),[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (prev.archivedSales !== next.archivedSales) {[39m
[31m+     manifest.archivedSalesOrder = salesOrderFromArray(next.archivedSales);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   await writeEntityManifest(manifest);[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     mode: "incremental",[39m
[31m+     entityWrites: stats.entityWrites,[39m
[31m+     bytesWritten: stats.bytesWritten,[39m
[31m+     durationMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+ /** Full snapshot for backups, disaster recovery, export, and legacy compatibility. */[39m
[31m+ export async function flushFullSnapshotPersist([39m
[31m+   state: PosState,[39m
[31m+   opts?: { skipLastGood?: boolean; skipEntityMigration?: boolean },[39m
[31m+ ): Promise<IncrementalPersistResult> {[39m
[31m+   const started = performance.now();[39m
[31m+   const { readEntityManifest } = await import("./entityStore");[39m
[31m+   const { snapshotFieldsFromTombstones, tombstonesFromManifest } = await import("../lib/tombstoneDurability");[39m
[31m+   const manifest = await readEntityManifest();[39m
[31m+   const tombstoneFields = manifest ? snapshotFieldsFromTombstones(tombstonesFromManifest(manifest)) : { deletedProductIds: [], voidedSaleIds: [] };[39m
[31m+ [39m
[31m+   const payload: Omit<PersistedSnapshot, "updatedAt"> = {[39m
[31m+     products: state.products,[39m
[31m+     customers: state.customers,[39m
[31m+     sales: state.sales,[39m
[31m+     preferences: state.preferences,[39m
[31m+     debtPayments: state.debtPayments,[39m
[31m+     dayCloses: state.dayCloses,[39m
[31m+     auditLogs: state.auditLogs,[39m
[31m+     suppliers: state.suppliers,[39m
[31m+     purchases: state.purchases,[39m
[31m+     supplierPayments: state.supplierPayments,[39m
[31m+     stockMovements: state.stockMovements,[39m
[31m+     archivedStockMovements: state.archivedStockMovements ?? [],[39m
[31m+     voidRecords: state.voidRecords,[39m
[31m+     returnRecords: state.returnRecords,[39m
[31m+     cashExpenses: state.cashExpenses,[39m
[31m+     cashDrawerAdjustments: state.cashDrawerAdjustments,[39m
[31m+     dayDrawerOpens: state.dayDrawerOpens,[39m
[31m+     inventoryCountSessions: state.inventoryCountSessions,[39m
[31m+     archivedSales: state.archivedSales,[39m
[31m+     archivedAuditLogs: state.archivedAuditLogs,[39m
[31m+     archivedDayCloses: state.archivedDayCloses,[39m
[31m+     archivedVoidRecords: state.archivedVoidRecords,[39m
[31m+     archivedReturnRecords: state.archivedReturnRecords,[39m
[31m+     pharmacyPrescriptions: state.pharmacyPrescriptions ?? [],[39m
[31m+     pharmacyDoctors: state.pharmacyDoctors ?? [],[39m
[31m+     pharmacyControlledRegister: state.pharmacyControlledRegister ?? [],[39m
[31m+     deletedProductIds: tombstoneFields.deletedProductIds,[39m
[31m+     voidedSaleIds: tombstoneFields.voidedSaleIds,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+   if (!opts?.skipEntityMigration) {[39m
[31m+     await migrateSnapshotToEntities({ ...payload, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   await writeSnapshot(payload, { skipLastGood: opts?.skipLastGood });[39m
[31m+   const bytesWritten = JSON.stringify(payload).length;[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     mode: "full",[39m
[31m+     entityWrites: state.products.length + state.customers.length + state.sales.length,[39m
[31m+     bytesWritten,[39m
[31m+     durationMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ export async function markProductDeleted(productId: string): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+   await deleteEntityRecord("product", productId);[39m
[31m+   const manifest = await readEntityManifest();[39m
[31m+   if (!manifest) return;[39m
[31m+   manifest.tombstones[productId] = new Date().toISOString();[39m
[31m+   await writeEntityManifest(manifest);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   if (!manifest) return;[39m

[31m+   await writeEntityManifest(manifest);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

import type { Permission, ShopPreferences, UserRole } from \"../types\";
import { canUseDevRoleSimulator, resolveAuthRole } from \"./permissions\";
import { resolveStaffPermissions } from \"./enterpriseRoles\";
import { displayWakaName } from \"./nameReview\";
import type { User } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";

export type SessionActor = {
  /** Commercial seller id — `staff:<id>` on shared-terminal PIN (Path S); frozen. */
  userId: string;
  /** Seller-facing role for POS sell context (may differ from authenticated operator). */
  role: UserRole;
  displayName?: string;
  /** Seller permission snapshot (custom staff roles / cached snapshot). */
  permissions?: Permission[];
  roleTemplateId?: string | null;
  customRoleId?: string | null;
  customRoleName?: string | null;
  /**
   * Commercial Auth seller for shared-terminal PIN (Path S).
   * Set when `userId` is `staff:<id>` and the profile has `linkedAuthUserId`.
   * Never replaces `userId`.
   */
  linkedAuthUserId?: string | null;
  /** Authenticated writer / device operator (JWT or Path L staff session). */
  authUserId?: string;
  /**
   * Shop membership / JWT role — never downgraded when owner selects PIN staff.
   * Not the permission operator on Path S; use `authOperatorRole`.
   */
  authRole?: UserRole;
  /** JWT/membership permission snapshot (Path L / Auth cashier). */
  authPermissions?: Permission[];
  /** Active PIN staff on shared terminal (`preferences.activeStaffId`). */
  activeStaffId?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Owner JWT + PIN staff on a shared terminal (Path S).
 * `authUserId` stays the shop account; `userId` is `staff:<id>`.
 */
export function isPathSOperatingStaff(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): boolean {
  const authId = actor.authUserId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  const userId = actor.userId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  return Boolean(authId && userId.startsWith(\"staff:\") && authId !== userId);
}

/**
 * JWT / shop_members role — never downgraded on Path S PIN.
 * Use for shared-terminal lock detection and cloud writer identity, not UI permission gates.
 */
export function authMembershipRole(actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authRole\" | \"role\">): UserRole {
  return actor.authRole ?? actor.role;
}

/**
 * Effective operating role for routes, store actions, home, and receipts.
 * Path S PIN staff uses seller `role` (least privilege). Auth cashier / Path L unchanged.
 */
export function authOperatorRole(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authRole\" | \"role\" | \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): UserRole {
  if (isPathSOperatingStaff(actor)) return actor.role;
  return actor.authRole ?? actor.role;
}

/**
 * Effective operator permission snapshot.
 * Path S PIN staff uses the staff row snapshot; otherwise JWT `authPermissions`.
 */
export function authOperatorPermissions(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authPermissions\" | \"permissions\" | \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): Permission[] | undefined {
  if (isPathSOperatingStaff(actor)) return actor.permissions;
  return actor.authPermissions;
}

/**
 * Shift owner id — authenticated writer (Phase 11b).
 * Path S: owner UUID while seller is `staff:<id>`. Path L / Auth cashier: same as `userId`.
 */
export function shiftOwnerUserId(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authUserId\" | \"userId\"> | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!actor) return null;
  const writer = actor.authUserId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  if (writer) return writer;
  return actor.userId;
}

function isAuthUuid(id: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!id) return false;
  return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id);
}

/** Normalize a linked Auth UUID from staff profile or session. */
export function normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const trimmed = raw?.trim() ?? \"\";
  return isAuthUuid(trimmed) ? trimmed : null;
}

/**
 * Commercial seller Auth UUID for cloud push.
 * Prefer explicit link; Auth cashiers already use UUID `userId`.
 */
export function commercialAuthUserIdFromActor(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"userId\" | \"linkedAuthUserId\"> | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!actor) return null;
  const linked = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(actor.linkedAuthUserId);
  if (linked) return linked;
  return isAuthUuid(actor.userId) ? actor.userId : null;
}

function devOverrideAllowed(): boolean {
  return !hasSupabaseConfig || Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);
}

/**
 * `devRoleOverride` in preferences applies only when dev override is allowed and
 * the authenticated role (before override) is owner — avoids cashiers escalating in prod.
 */
export function resolveSessionActor(params: {
  mode: \"supabase\" | \"local\";
  user: User | null;
  email: string | null | undefined;
  preferences: ShopPreferences;
  /** From `shop_members` — preferred over user metadata for Supabase sessions. */
  shopMemberRole?: UserRole | null;
  /** Offline staff login — never treat as owner while store hydrates. */
  staffSession?: {
    staffId: string;
    staffName: string;
    role: UserRole;
    permissions?: Permission[];
    roleTemplateId?: string | null;
    customRoleId?: string | null;
    linkedAuthUserId?: string | null;
  } | null;
}): SessionActor {
  if (params.staffSession) {
    const fromSession = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(params.staffSession.linkedAuthUserId);
    const fromAccount = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(
      (params.preferences.staffAccounts ?? []).find((s) => s.id === params.staffSession!.staffId)
        ?.linkedAuthUserId,
    );
    const staffUserId = `staff:${params.staffSession.staffId}`;
    return {
      userId: staffUserId,
      role: params.staffSession.role,
      displayName: params.staffSession.staffName,
      permissions: params.staffSession.permissions,
      roleTemplateId: params.staffSession.roleTemplateId,
      customRoleId: params.staffSession.customRoleId,
      linkedAuthUserId: fromSession ?? fromAccount,
      authUserId: staffUserId,
      authRole: params.staffSession.role,
      authPermissions: params.staffSession.permissions,
      activeStaffId: params.staffSession.staffId,
    };
  }

  const meta = params.user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  const authRole = resolveAuthRole({
    mode: params.mode,
    userMetadata: meta,
    shopMemberRole: params.shopMemberRole,
  });
  const devAllowed = devOverrideAllowed();
  const override = params.preferences.devRoleOverride;
  const simulatedRole: UserRole =
    devAllowed && override && canUseDevRoleSimulator(authRole) ? override : authRole;
  /** Owner switched to a staff profile on this device (lock screen / switch user). */
  const activeStaff =
    authRole === \"owner\" && params.preferences.activeStaffId
      ? (params.preferences.staffAccounts ?? []).find(
          (s) => s.id === params.preferences.activeStaffId && s.active,
        )
      : undefined;
  const role: UserRole = activeStaff?.role ?? simulatedRole;
  const customRoleName =
    activeStaff?.customRoleId != null
      ? (params.preferences.customStaffRoles ?? []).find((r) => r.id === activeStaff.customRoleId)?.name
      : undefined;
  const staffPermissions = activeStaff
    ? resolveStaffPermissions(activeStaff, params.preferences.customStaffRoles)
    : undefined;

  const baseUserId =
    params.user?.id ?? (params.email ? `local:${params.email.trim().toLowerCase()}` : \"local:anonymous\");
  const userId = activeStaff ? `staff:${activeStaff.id}` : baseUserId;

  // DISPLAY AUTHORITY. The confirmed DKASU name wins; the provider's suggestion is only a fallback
  // for someone who has not confirmed one. Reading `user_metadata.full_name` directly — as this
  // did — meant a rename at Google changed the name shown throughout DKASU with no DKASU write at
  // all. `displayWakaName` reads the confirmed pair first, and needs no network call: the metadata
  // is already on the session this function is handed.
  const displayName =
    activeStaff?.name ||
    displayWakaName(
      params.user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
      params.user?.email ?? params.email,
    ) ||
    undefined;

  return {
    userId,
    role,
    displayName,
    permissions: staffPermissions,
    roleTemplateId: activeStaff?.roleTemplateId,
    customRoleId: activeStaff?.customRoleId,
    customRoleName,
    linkedAuthUserId: activeStaff
      ? normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(activeStaff.linkedAuthUserId)
      : normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(params.user?.id),
    authUserId: baseUserId,
    authRole: simulatedRole,
    activeStaffId: activeStaff?.id ?? params.preferences.activeStaffId ?? null,
  };
}

   * Never replaces `userId`.
   */
  linkedAuthUserId?: string | null;
  /** Authenticated writer / device operator (JWT or Path L staff session). */
  authUserId?: string;
  /**
   * Shop membership / JWT role — never downgraded when owner selects PIN staff.
   * Not the permission operator on Path S; use `authOperatorRole`.
   */
  authRole?: UserRole;
  /** JWT/membership permission snapshot (Path L / Auth cashier). */
  authPermissions?: Permission[];
  /** Active PIN staff on shared terminal (`preferences.activeStaffId`). */
  activeStaffId?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Owner JWT + PIN staff on a shared terminal (Path S).
 * `authUserId` stays the shop account; `userId` is `staff:<id>`.
 */
export function isPathSOperatingStaff(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): boolean {
  const authId = actor.authUserId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  const userId = actor.userId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  return Boolean(authId && userId.startsWith(\"staff:\") && authId !== userId);
}

/**
 * JWT / shop_members role — never downgraded on Path S PIN.
 * Use for shared-terminal lock detection and cloud writer identity, not UI permission gates.
 */
export function authMembershipRole(actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authRole\" | \"role\">): UserRole {
  return actor.authRole ?? actor.role;
}

/**
 * Effective operating role for routes, store actions, home, and receipts.
 * Path S PIN staff uses seller `role` (least privilege). Auth cashier / Path L unchanged.
 */
export function authOperatorRole(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authRole\" | \"role\" | \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): UserRole {
  if (isPathSOperatingStaff(actor)) return actor.role;
  return actor.authRole ?? actor.role;
}

/**
 * Effective operator permission snapshot.
 * Path S PIN staff uses the staff row snapshot; otherwise JWT `authPermissions`.
 */
export function authOperatorPermissions(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authPermissions\" | \"permissions\" | \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): Permission[] | undefined {
  if (isPathSOperatingStaff(actor)) return actor.permissions;
  return actor.authPermissions;
}

/**
 * Shift owner id — authenticated writer (Phase 11b).
 * Path S: owner UUID while seller is `staff:<id>`. Path L / Auth cashier: same as `userId`.
 */
export function shiftOwnerUserId(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authUserId\" | \"userId\"> | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!actor) return null;
  const writer = actor.authUserId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  if (writer) return writer;
  return actor.userId;
}

function isAuthUuid(id: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!id) return false;
  return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id);
}

/** Normalize a linked Auth UUID from staff profile or session. */
export function normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const trimmed = raw?.trim() ?? \"\";
  return isAuthUuid(trimmed) ? trimmed : null;
}

/**
 * Commercial seller Auth UUID for cloud push.
 * Prefer explicit link; Auth cashiers already use UUID `userId`.
 */
export function commercialAuthUserIdFromActor(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"userId\" | \"linkedAuthUserId\"> | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!actor) return null;
  const linked = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(actor.linkedAuthUserId);
  if (linked) return linked;
  return isAuthUuid(actor.userId) ? actor.userId : null;
}

function devOverrideAllowed(): boolean {
  return !hasSupabaseConfig || Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);
}

/**
 * `devRoleOverride` in preferences applies only when dev override is allowed and
 * the authenticated role (before override) is owner — avoids cashiers escalating in prod.
 */
export function resolveSessionActor(params: {
  mode: \"supabase\" | \"local\";
  user: User | null;
  email: string | null | undefined;
  preferences: ShopPreferences;
  /** From `shop_members` — preferred over user metadata for Supabase sessions. */
  shopMemberRole?: UserRole | null;
  /** Offline staff login — never treat as owner while store hydrates. */
  staffSession?: {
    staffId: string;
    staffName: string;
    role: UserRole;
    permissions?: Permission[];
    roleTemplateId?: string | null;
    customRoleId?: string | null;
    linkedAuthUserId?: string | null;
  } | null;
}): SessionActor {
  if (params.staffSession) {
    const fromSession = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(params.staffSession.linkedAuthUserId);
    const fromAccount = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(
      (params.preferences.staffAccounts ?? []).find((s) => s.id === params.staffSession!.staffId)
        ?.linkedAuthUserId,
    );
    const staffUserId = `staff:${params.staffSession.staffId}`;
    return {
      userId: staffUserId,
      role: params.staffSession.role,
      displayName: params.staffSession.staffName,
      permissions: params.staffSession.permissions,
      roleTemplateId: params.staffSession.roleTemplateId,
      customRoleId: params.staffSession.customRoleId,
      linkedAuthUserId: fromSession ?? fromAccount,
      authUserId: staffUserId,
      authRole: params.staffSession.role,
      authPermissions: params.staffSession.permissions,
      activeStaffId: params.staffSession.staffId,
    };
  }

  const meta = params.user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  const authRole = resolveAuthRole({
    mode: params.mode,
    userMetadata: meta,
    shopMemberRole: params.shopMemberRole,
  });
  const devAllowed = devOverrideAllowed();
  const override = params.preferences.devRoleOverride;
  const simulatedRole: UserRole =
    devAllowed && override && canUseDevRoleSimulator(authRole) ? override : authRole;
  /** Owner switched to a staff profile on this device (lock screen / switch user). */
  const activeStaff =
    authRole === \"owner\" && params.preferences.activeStaffId
      ? (params.preferences.staffAccounts ?? []).find(
          (s) => s.id === params.preferences.activeStaffId && s.active,
        )
      : undefined;
  const role: UserRole = activeStaff?.role ?? simulatedRole;
  const customRoleName =
    activeStaff?.customRoleId != null
      ? (params.preferences.customStaffRoles ?? []).find((r) => r.id === activeStaff.customRoleId)?.name
      : undefined;
  const staffPermissions = activeStaff
    ? resolveStaffPermissions(activeStaff, params.preferences.customStaffRoles)
    : undefined;

  const baseUserId =
    params.user?.id ?? (params.email ? `local:${params.email.trim().toLowerCase()}` : \"local:anonymous\");
  const userId = activeStaff ? `staff:${activeStaff.id}` : baseUserId;

  // DISPLAY AUTHORITY. The confirmed DKASU name wins; the provider's suggestion is only a fallback
  // for someone who has not confirmed one. Reading `user_metadata.full_name` directly — as this
  // did — meant a rename at Google changed the name shown throughout DKASU with no DKASU write at
  // all. `displayWakaName` reads the confirmed pair first, and needs no network call: the metadata
  // is already on the session this function is handed.
  const displayName =
    activeStaff?.name ||
    displayWakaName(
      params.user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
      params.user?.email ?? params.email,
    ) ||
    undefined;

  return {
    userId,
    role,
    displayName,
    permissions: staffPermissions,
    roleTemplateId: activeStaff?.roleTemplateId,
    customRoleId: activeStaff?.customRoleId,
    customRoleName,
    linkedAuthUserId: activeStaff
      ? normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(activeStaff.linkedAuthUserId)
      : normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(params.user?.id),
    authUserId: baseUserId,
    authRole: simulatedRole,
    activeStaffId: activeStaff?.id ?? params.preferences.activeStaffId ?? null,
  };
}

import type { Permission, ShopPreferences, UserRole } from \"../types\";
import { canUseDevRoleSimulator, resolveAuthRole } from \"./permissions\";
import { resolveStaffPermissions } from \"./enterpriseRoles\";
import { displayWakaName } from \"./nameReview\";
import type { User } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";

export type SessionActor = {
  /** Commercial seller id — `staff:<id>` on shared-terminal PIN (Path S); frozen. */
  userId: string;
  /** Seller-facing role for POS sell context (may differ from authenticated operator). */
  role: UserRole;
  displayName?: string;
  /** Seller permission snapshot (custom staff roles / cached snapshot). */
  permissions?: Permission[];
  roleTemplateId?: string | null;
  customRoleId?: string | null;
  customRoleName?: string | null;
  /**
   * Commercial Auth seller for shared-terminal PIN (Path S).
   * Set when `userId` is `staff:<id>` and the profile has `linkedAuthUserId`.
   * Never replaces `userId`.
   */
  linkedAuthUserId?: string | null;
  /** Authenticated writer / device operator (JWT or Path L staff session). */
  authUserId?: string;
  /**
   * Shop membership / JWT role — never downgraded when owner selects PIN staff.
   * Not the permission operator on Path S; use `authOperatorRole`.
   */
  authRole?: UserRole;
  /** JWT/membership permission snapshot (Path L / Auth cashier). */
  authPermissions?: Permission[];
  /** Active PIN staff on shared terminal (`preferences.activeStaffId`). */
  activeStaffId?: string | null;
};

/**
 * Owner JWT + PIN staff on a shared terminal (Path S).
 * `authUserId` stays the shop account; `userId` is `staff:<id>`.
 */
export function isPathSOperatingStaff(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): boolean {
  const authId = actor.authUserId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  const userId = actor.userId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  return Boolean(authId && userId.startsWith(\"staff:\") && authId !== userId);
}

/**
 * JWT / shop_members role — never downgraded on Path S PIN.
 * Use for shared-terminal lock detection and cloud writer identity, not UI permission gates.
 */
export function authMembershipRole(actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authRole\" | \"role\">): UserRole {
  return actor.authRole ?? actor.role;
}

/**
 * Effective operating role for routes, store actions, home, and receipts.
 * Path S PIN staff uses seller `role` (least privilege). Auth cashier / Path L unchanged.
 */
export function authOperatorRole(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authRole\" | \"role\" | \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): UserRole {
  if (isPathSOperatingStaff(actor)) return actor.role;
  return actor.authRole ?? actor.role;
}

/**
 * Effective operator permission snapshot.
 * Path S PIN staff uses the staff row snapshot; otherwise JWT `authPermissions`.
 */
export function authOperatorPermissions(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authPermissions\" | \"permissions\" | \"userId\" | \"authUserId\">,
): Permission[] | undefined {
  if (isPathSOperatingStaff(actor)) return actor.permissions;
  return actor.authPermissions;
}

/**
 * Shift owner id — authenticated writer (Phase 11b).
 * Path S: owner UUID while seller is `staff:<id>`. Path L / Auth cashier: same as `userId`.
 */
export function shiftOwnerUserId(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"authUserId\" | \"userId\"> | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!actor) return null;
  const writer = actor.authUserId?.trim() ?? \"\";
  if (writer) return writer;
  return actor.userId;
}

function isAuthUuid(id: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!id) return false;
  return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(id);
}

/** Normalize a linked Auth UUID from staff profile or session. */
export function normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(raw: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const trimmed = raw?.trim() ?? \"\";
  return isAuthUuid(trimmed) ? trimmed : null;
}

/**
 * Commercial seller Auth UUID for cloud push.
 * Prefer explicit link; Auth cashiers already use UUID `userId`.
 */
export function commercialAuthUserIdFromActor(
  actor: Pick<SessionActor, \"userId\" | \"linkedAuthUserId\"> | null | undefined,
): string | null {
  if (!actor) return null;
  const linked = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(actor.linkedAuthUserId);
  if (linked) return linked;
  return isAuthUuid(actor.userId) ? actor.userId : null;
}

function devOverrideAllowed(): boolean {
  return !hasSupabaseConfig || Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);
}

/**
 * `devRoleOverride` in preferences applies only when dev override is allowed and
 * the authenticated role (before override) is owner — avoids cashiers escalating in prod.
 */
export function resolveSessionActor(params: {
  mode: \"supabase\" | \"local\";
  user: User | null;
  email: string | null | undefined;
  preferences: ShopPreferences;
  /** From `shop_members` — preferred over user metadata for Supabase sessions. */
  shopMemberRole?: UserRole | null;
  /** Offline staff login — never treat as owner while store hydrates. */
  staffSession?: {
    staffId: string;
    staffName: string;
    role: UserRole;
    permissions?: Permission[];
    roleTemplateId?: string | null;
    customRoleId?: string | null;
    linkedAuthUserId?: string | null;
  } | null;
}): SessionActor {
  if (params.staffSession) {
    const fromSession = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(params.staffSession.linkedAuthUserId);
    const fromAccount = normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(
      (params.preferences.staffAccounts ?? []).find((s) => s.id === params.staffSession!.staffId)
        ?.linkedAuthUserId,
    );
    const staffUserId = `staff:${params.staffSession.staffId}`;
    return {
      userId: staffUserId,
      role: params.staffSession.role,
      displayName: params.staffSession.staffName,
      permissions: params.staffSession.permissions,
      roleTemplateId: params.staffSession.roleTemplateId,
      customRoleId: params.staffSession.customRoleId,
      linkedAuthUserId: fromSession ?? fromAccount,
      authUserId: staffUserId,
      authRole: params.staffSession.role,
      authPermissions: params.staffSession.permissions,
      activeStaffId: params.staffSession.staffId,
    };
  }

  const meta = params.user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  const authRole = resolveAuthRole({
    mode: params.mode,
    userMetadata: meta,
    shopMemberRole: params.shopMemberRole,
  });
  const devAllowed = devOverrideAllowed();
  const override = params.preferences.devRoleOverride;
  const simulatedRole: UserRole =
    devAllowed && override && canUseDevRoleSimulator(authRole) ? override : authRole;
  /** Owner switched to a staff profile on this device (lock screen / switch user). */
  const activeStaff =
    authRole === \"owner\" && params.preferences.activeStaffId
      ? (params.preferences.staffAccounts ?? []).find(
          (s) => s.id === params.preferences.activeStaffId && s.active,
        )
      : undefined;
  const role: UserRole = activeStaff?.role ?? simulatedRole;
  const customRoleName =
    activeStaff?.customRoleId != null
      ? (params.preferences.customStaffRoles ?? []).find((r) => r.id === activeStaff.customRoleId)?.name
      : undefined;
  const staffPermissions = activeStaff
    ? resolveStaffPermissions(activeStaff, params.preferences.customStaffRoles)
    : undefined;

  const baseUserId =
    params.user?.id ?? (params.email ? `local:${params.email.trim().toLowerCase()}` : \"local:anonymous\");
  const userId = activeStaff ? `staff:${activeStaff.id}` : baseUserId;

  // DISPLAY AUTHORITY. The confirmed DKASU name wins; the provider's suggestion is only a fallback
  // for someone who has not confirmed one. Reading `user_metadata.full_name` directly — as this
  // did — meant a rename at Google changed the name shown throughout DKASU with no DKASU write at
  // all. `displayWakaName` reads the confirmed pair first, and needs no network call: the metadata
  // is already on the session this function is handed.
  const displayName =
    activeStaff?.name ||
    displayWakaName(
      params.user?.user_metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
      params.user?.email ?? params.email,
    ) ||
    undefined;

  return {
    userId,
    role,
    displayName,
    permissions: staffPermissions,
    roleTemplateId: activeStaff?.roleTemplateId,
    customRoleId: activeStaff?.customRoleId,
    customRoleName,
    linkedAuthUserId: activeStaff
      ? normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(activeStaff.linkedAuthUserId)
      : normalizeLinkedAuthUserId(params.user?.id),
    authUserId: baseUserId,
    authRole: simulatedRole,
    activeStaffId: activeStaff?.id ?? params.preferences.activeStaffId ?? null,
  };
}
